question: The nuclear power plant CHASHMA-III is located in?
solution:
The correct answer is **Pakistan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chashma-III** is one of the nuclear power plants located in Pakistan.
 
• It is situated near the town of Chashma, in the Punjab province.
 
• The plant is operated by the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission (PAEC).
 
• Chashma-III started its commercial operation in 2016.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1: Bangladesh
 Bangladesh does not have a nuclear power plant named Chashma-III.
 
 

 Option 2: India
 India has several nuclear power plants, but Chashma-III is not one of them.
 
 

 Option 3: Afghanistan
 Afghanistan does not have any operational nuclear power plants.
